preconditions.description: Input string length is between 1 and 100 characters, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(33 <= ord(c) <= 127 for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: All characters in input string have ASCII codes between 33 and 127, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if stdin == username + '@' + hostname + (('/' + resource) if '/' in stdin else '') and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for c in username) and 1 <= len(username) <= 16 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for c in resource) and 1 <= len(resource) <= 16 and '@' in stdin and (resource_part := stdin.split('@')[1].split('/')[0]) == hostname and all(part in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for part in hostname.split('.')) and 1 <= len(hostname) <= 32 and all(1 <= len(part) <= 16 for part in hostname.split('.')) and (resource_part := stdin.split('@')[1].split('/')[1] if '/' in stdin else '') and 1 <= len(resource_part) <= 16 else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Outputs 'YES' if and only if the input string matches the Jabber ID format: <username>@<hostname>[/resource], where <username> and <resource> are valid sequences of allowed characters with lengths between 1 and 16, <hostname> is a valid sequence of words separated by dots with each word length between 1 and 16 and total length between 1 and 32, and the optional resource part follows the '/' character.
